critical_issues: 3-year term with 90-day notice for non-renewal (auto-renews annually after)
Liability capped at 12 months fees per product/service
90-day software warranty is short for enterprise software
Annual maintenance costs 20% of license fee (ongoing expense)
Seller may reject POs within 5 days (no guaranteed acceptance)
License restrictions prevent modifications or service bureau use
strengths: Master agreement framework provides purchasing flexibility
Reasonable liability cap with standard exclusions
Work product from services becomes Buyer's property
rationale: Standard master purchase agreement with balanced terms. Provides framework for ongoing software purchases with reasonable protections for both parties. Liability caps, warranty periods, and payment terms are industry-standard.
